source.title: Software Security Code of Practice - Implementation Guidance: Theme 1 - Secure design and development
source.applicability: Official vendor guidance covering threat modeling techniques, secure coding requirements, dependency risk assessment, and security review processes throughout development lifecycle. Aligns with ISO 27001 controls.

passages.text: Threat modelling: techniques used to understand how the software might be attacked or fail in some other way.
